real_object_mode.note: Exercises the explicit initial-mask entrypoint separately; it is not an independent object-mask accuracy benchmark.

limits: CFR frame-index timing is assumed; VFR is not detected. Mask cadence can repeat/drop source frames, never interpolate.
Tagged HDR is refused and must be explicitly converted before processing; absence of HDR tags is not proof of SDR.
User supervision identifies the target. Color and flow gates cannot prove semantic identity.
No all-video frame array is retained; source and analysis masks are cached to disk, propagation holds two frames.
Straight solid spanning occluders and a single monotonic pass are required for reveal. The object mask is never directly substituted for B alpha.
After a verified border exit, every remaining border is checked for foreground-like spanning content; this color check cannot detect every re-entry or prove absence.
Near the final border a <=2%-width, <=1.5%-area observed sliver uses actual silhouette coverage; no fake full-frame object masks or endpoint padding are added.
Low dense coverage on airport frames 18 and 20 is explicitly reported and accepted only because independent geometry and image-edge checks pass.
Airport comparison uses an existing manually prepared reveal reference, not pixel-perfect semantic ground truth. New synthetic masks provide exact ground truth.
The output directory is staged and validated before rename; backup/replace is not a cross-operation transaction and does not coordinate concurrent writers.
Assets have no audio. Audio is a later rendering decision.

visual_review.observations: Swept B side follows the visible trailing gray pillar edge; small matte irregularities remain in object alpha, and a tiny border fragment is retained at local frame21.
